title: Editorial: Generative AI in education
extended_summary:
This editorial introduces a Frontiers Research Topic on generative AI in education and synthesizes the themes addressed across 11 papers in the volume. The piece focuses on how generative AI may reshape educational practice through personalized content generation, AI tutors, automated feedback, assessment support, and learner modeling, while also highlighting risks and governance concerns such as privacy, ethics, transparency, bias, and accuracy.

Rather than reporting a single empirical study, the editorial summarizes the contributions of multiple articles spanning perspectives, original research, opinion pieces, and a mini-review. The included papers cover uses such as LLM-based feedback generation, adolescent schoolwork use of AI chatbots, support for critical thinking, pre-service teacher mathematical proof generation, whole-learner support, personalized assessment, AI mentors for STEM career exploration, responsible integration, interactive listening task generation, and deception detection with educational robots.

Because this is an editorial, it does not focus on one participant population or school implementation setting. The paper’s main conclusion is that generative AI has significant promise for education, but its effective and ethical adoption will require continued research and careful attention to human oversight, interpretability, responsible use, and alignment with educational goals and standards.

identified_tools.name: GenAI (General)
identified_tools.description: Generic generative AI / large language model chatbot systems used for educational content generation, tutoring, feedback, and personalization.
identified_tools.use_case: This editorial surveys a research topic on generative AI in education and summarizes multiple included papers rather than evaluating one named product. It discusses generative AI chatbots and LLMs for feedback, tutoring, assessment, mentoring, and related educational uses.

quality_tier_rationale: This is an editorial/opinion piece summarizing a research topic, not a primary empirical evaluation or systematic review with an explicit search and synthesis method. It does not report original tool-level outcomes.
impact_tier_rationale: No effect sizes, controlled comparisons, or outcome data are reported for a specific AI tool in this paper. The article is descriptive and conceptual rather than evidentiary.
